title: Crazy Kutumba
desc: When Gowri gets selected for a dance competition, she travels to Bangalore with her dysfunctional family. During this journey, they get to know each other and iron out their differences.

title: Rayaru Bandaru Mavana Manege
desc: Suma and Vishnu act as a married couple to please her father. However, they get into trouble when her father finds out the truth.

title: Kalki
desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a group of people set out to save a woman pregnant with Lord Vishnu's 10th and final avatar, Kalki, from an evil supreme god-king, Yaskin.

title: Yajamana
desc: Devi Shetty, a cruel gangster, is out to plunder a village's oil resources and ruin its inhabitants' livelihood. However, the son-in-law of the village head, Krishna, stands in his way.

title: UI
desc: In a dystopian world, people of all races and religions co-exist. However, misuse of power and technology creates a conflict between Sathya and Kalki.

title: A
desc: A film director fades away from the industry after the failed love with the heroine of his movie. After being rehabilitated, he learns that some people conspired his fall and decides to take revenge.
